prompt: Did Pelosi buy any tech stocks recently?
expected_output: Congress-only mode with --member 'Nancy Pelosi' filter, last 30-90 days, transaction list

assertions.name: filters_by_member_name
assertions.description: Output must filter by Pelosi (or politician in general if Pelosi has no recent trades)

assertions.name: uses_congress_data_source
assertions.description: Output must reference congress trades (STOCK Act, InsiderFinance, or Quiver Quant)
assertions.check: output contains 'congress' or 'STOCK Act' or 'InsiderFinance' or 'disclosure'

assertions.name: time_window_specified
assertions.description: Output must specify a time window (last 30 / 60 / 90 days, or explicit dates)
assertions.check: output contains 'days' or 'last' or '30' or '60' or '90' or '202' (year reference)

assertions.name: mentions_transaction_or_ticker
assertions.description: Output must include transaction type or ticker symbols
assertions.check: output contains 'purchase' or 'sale' or 'buy' or 'sell' or any ticker pattern (1-5 uppercase letters) or 'NVDA' or 'AAPL' or 'MSFT' or 'TSLA' or 'GOOGL' or 'META' or 'AMZN'
